name: start
step: Start: jfred branch Layer3-9 has Layers 1-2 built and signed off, L4's script-run drawer half built (task 356), static mockups only for L5 and L6, nothing for L3, L7, L8, L9; typecheck and 1085 capture-free tests pass; 18 open tasks hang under umbrella task 340; code for closed tasks 363, 364, 366, 213, 344 sits only on jfred branch staging.

name: merge-stranded-jfred
step: Merge jfred branch staging into jfred Layer3-9 with --no-ff so the code for tasks 363, 364, 366, 213 and 344 is on the mainline.
why: Those five tasks are closed but their code is on no mainline branch; later layers edit the same files.
how: git -C jfred merge --no-ff staging; expect conflicts in webapp/layer1-page.ts; done when `git -C jfred cherry Layer3-9 staging` prints no + lines.

name: merge-stranded-reveng
step: Merge RevEng branch staging into RevEng Layer3-9 with --no-ff so plans/l6-node-states-mockup/ (task 381) lands and the jfred gitlink points at the merged jfred commit.
why: The L6 mockup step needs the task-381 files, which exist only on RevEng staging.
how: git merge --no-ff staging; then git add jfred; done when `git cherry Layer3-9 staging` prints no + lines.

name: post-merge-green
step: Typecheck and npm run test:ci pass in jfred after both merges.
why: The merged code was never tested together on Layer3-9.

name: retire-data-layer
step: Task 352: the data-layer attribute and all its readers are retired in one commit.
why: The L8 show-row replaces the data-layer gate, and the L3 mockup (343) is blocked on it.

name: l8-mockup
step: An in-page fixture-mode mockup of the L8 show-row checkboxes (spec S23) renders on the live layer1 page.
why: Visual-first rule: the user sees every layer before code is built.
how: Fixture mode via isFixtureMode in src/viewer_api_layer1_fixture.ts; spec S23 at specs/from-scratch-SPEC.md line ~933.

name: l8-signoff
step: The user signs off the L8 mockup.
why: Build work on a layer starts only after its visual is approved.

name: l8-build
step: Task 360: the data-driven show-row checkboxes filter node kinds on the live page, with DOM tests under jfred/tests.
why: L3's mockup (343) consumes the show-row; strict spec order is kept because L8 only replaces a toggle that already exists.

name: l8-real-check
step: A real-data browser check of L8 passes: the live page loads jot-recovery data and a CDP screenshot from jfred/scripts/visual shows the show-row working.
why: Fixture tests cannot prove real data renders.

name: l8-use
step: The user uses the L8 show-row on real jot data and confirms it filters as expected.
why: The layer counts as working only when the user has used it.

name: split-layer2-fixture
step: Task 354: the layer-2 fixture data is split out of viewer_api_layer1_fixture_data.ts.
why: L3 and L4 fixture files are added next to it; the file is over the 250-line cap.

name: split-drawer-test
step: Task 378: jfred/tests/layer1-drawer.test.ts (519 lines) is split into files under the 150-line cap.
why: L3 build adds .n-edit coverage to this file; the cap hook blocks edits until it is split.

name: l3-mockup
step: Task 343: an in-page fixture-mode mockup of L3 extracted Edit/Write nodes (spec S20) renders on the live layer1 page.
why: Visual-first rule.
how: New viewer_api_layer3_fixture_data.ts; .n-edit nodes; tokens from plans/node-kinds-mockup.

name: l3-signoff
step: The user signs off the L3 mockup.
why: Build work on a layer starts only after its visual is approved.

name: l3-build
step: Task 355: the engine emits L3 beacons and extracted Edit/Write nodes on the wire (edits? on the pair) and the page renders them, with DOM tests under jfred/tests.
why: L5 lanes, L7 node types and L9 markers all attach to L3 nodes.
how: extractFileEvents in src/reconstruction_extract.ts feeds layer1 wire in webapp/layer1-wire.ts.

name: l3-real-check
step: A real-data browser check of L3 passes: real jot-recovery sessions show Edit/Write nodes in a CDP screenshot.
why: Fixture tests cannot prove real data renders.

name: l3-use
step: The user clicks L3 nodes on real jot data and confirms each replays the right edit.
why: The layer counts as working only when the user has used it.

name: l4-fixture
step: Task 377: viewer_api_layer4_fixture_data.ts exists with the contentLines scriptRun branch.
why: The L4 in-page mockup needs fixture data.

name: l4-mockup
step: An in-page fixture-mode mockup of L4 script-run nodes (spec S21) renders on the live layer1 page.
why: Visual-first rule; the signed-off S14 mockup was a standalone HTML file, not the live page.

name: l4-signoff
step: The user signs off the L4 mockup.
why: Build work on a layer starts only after its visual is approved.

name: l4-wire-real
step: The layer1 server fills scriptRuns on the wire from the real engine so script-run nodes appear for real sessions.
why: Task 356 built the drawer but nothing in viewer_api_layer1*.ts fills scriptRuns; real data shows no L4 nodes.
how: Chain findScriptExecutionRuns -> resolveScriptIndirection in src/reconstruction_script_execution.ts into src/viewer_api_layer1*.ts; this is a new task.

name: l4-real-check
step: A real-data browser check of L4 passes: a CDP screenshot shows script-run nodes and the shared drawer on real jot data.
why: Fixture tests cannot prove real data renders.

name: l4-use
step: The user opens L4 script-run nodes on real jot data and confirms the script body and per-file diffs are right.
why: The layer counts as working only when the user has used it.

name: l5-mockup
step: Task 379: an in-page fixture-mode mockup of L5 forked-lane branch rendering (spec S25) renders on the live layer1 page.
why: Visual-first rule; plans/layer5-branch-mockup/ chose the design but is not on the page.

name: l5-signoff
step: The user signs off the L5 mockup.
why: Build work on a layer starts only after its visual is approved.

name: l5-stitching
step: Task 380: the engine grafts a forked subagent session's branch onto its parent conversation tree.
why: L5 lanes are conversation-wide across subagent sessions (decision 2026-08-01).

name: l5-build
step: Task 357: branches render as forked lanes inside per-file bubbles on the live page, with DOM tests.
why: This is the L5 deliverable.

name: l5-real-check
step: A real-data browser check of L5 passes: a CDP screenshot shows a forked lane on a real jot session that has a rewind.
why: Fixture tests cannot prove real data renders.

name: l5-use
step: The user follows a forked lane on real jot data and confirms kept and rejected branches read correctly.
why: The layer counts as working only when the user has used it.

name: l6-mockup
step: An in-page fixture-mode mockup of the L6 execution console popup and node states (spec S26) renders on the live layer1 page.
why: Visual-first rule; plans/l6-console-mockup/ and plans/l6-node-states-mockup/ are static files, not the page.

name: l6-signoff
step: The user signs off the L6 mockup.
why: Build work on a layer starts only after its visual is approved.

name: l6-build
step: Task 358: on-demand script execution replay runs from the page with the consent gate and terminal states, with tests.
why: This is the L6 deliverable.
how: executeRunOnce in src/reconstruction_script_runs.ts; scriptCodeMayWriteFiles gate stays.

name: l6-real-check
step: A real-data browser check of L6 passes: a CDP run replays one real jot script and the console shows its terminal state.
why: Fixture tests cannot prove real data renders.

name: l6-use
step: The user replays a script on real jot data and confirms the console output and mismatch styling.
why: The layer counts as working only when the user has used it.

name: l7-mockup
step: Task 382: an in-page fixture-mode mockup of L7 remaining node types, tool_use/tool_result brackets, the [?] catch-all and the session annotation track (spec S22) renders on the live page.
why: Visual-first rule.

name: l7-signoff
step: The user signs off the L7 mockup.
why: Build work on a layer starts only after its visual is approved.

name: l7-build
step: Task 359: every record type gets a node, the hide-ignored toggle and annotation track work on the live page, with tests.
why: This is the L7 deliverable.

name: l7-real-check
step: A real-data browser check of L7 passes: a CDP screenshot on real jot data shows no record type falling into [?] unexpectedly.
why: Fixture tests cannot prove real data renders.

name: l7-use
step: The user reads a real jot session with L7 on and confirms every node kind is understandable.
why: The layer counts as working only when the user has used it.

name: l8-order-check
step: L8 is confirmed complete at its strict-order slot: steps 'l8-build' through 'l8-use' are done and nothing from L3-L7 regressed the show-row.
why: L8 was pulled forward for L3; this step keeps the strict order honest.

name: l9-mockup
step: Task 383: an in-page fixture-mode mockup of L9 ruler-range arming, cut marks and the jfred-branch commit strip (spec S24) renders on the live page.
why: Visual-first rule.

name: l9-signoff
step: The user signs off the L9 mockup.
why: Build work on a layer starts only after its visual is approved.

name: l9-build
step: Task 361: a ruler range exports a git diff and commits it onto a hidden jfred branch, with the refs filter and tests.
why: This is the L9 deliverable and the spec's segment-patch half of Done.
how: render_git_diff.ts; filter jfred out in buildLayer1RefsView; message contains 'includes N unmarked changes'.

name: l9-real-check
step: A real-data check of L9 passes: a range on real jot data produces a commit on the jfred branch and `git apply` of its diff is clean.
why: The spec's Done sentence requires a patch that applies cleanly.

name: l9-use
step: The user cuts a range on real jot data, commits it, and confirms the commit content.
why: The layer counts as working only when the user has used it.

name: debt-clean
step: The debt-catcher hook flags zero style debt across jfred and RevEng.
why: The user requires all flagged style debt cleared before the goal.
how: Run the hook's checker over every file touched since 'start'; fix each item.

name: full-suite-green
step: Typecheck and the full `npm test` (with scenario captures) pass in jfred.
why: test:ci skips capture tests; the full suite is the real bar.

name: whole-page-signoff
step: The user loads the live layer1 page with all layers on against real jot-recovery data and signs off the whole page.
why: The user required a final whole-page sign-off, not only green tests.

name: close-340
step: Task 340 and every child are closed in completedTasks.json with real commit hashes, and both repos are pushed.
why: 340 is the milestone marker; the goal is reached when it closes.

name: goal
step: Goal: Spec items S20-S26 (Layers 3-9) are built into the live jfred Layer 1 page by plain agents, each layer's visual is signed off by the user, typecheck and the full test suite pass, and umbrella task 340 is closed.
